semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Fang Jie Co., Ltd. distributes advanced gas detection and monitoring solutions critical for semiconductor manufacturing environments.
summary: Fang Jie Co., Ltd. is a distributor of advanced gas detection and monitoring solutions in Taiwan, with a focus on the semiconductor industry. They provide gas detectors and monitors for toxic gases, VOCs, and combustible gases, as well as analytical instruments like FTIR spectrometers and particle monitors. Their services include system integration, maintenance, and repair, catering to the stringent demands of semiconductor manufacturing.
capabilities: Gas detectors for toxic and combustible gases
FTIR spectrometers for air and liquid quality monitoring
